'''Jenna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] heritage. She and [[Jenna's father|her father]] were part of a group of colonists that settled a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Her father served as the [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] of the Corellian settlement, located in the planet's [[Sector Fifteen|fifteenth sector]], until he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by order of [[Bo-Dum]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Following the sheriff's death, Jenna and the other settlers lived under the rule of Bo-Dum and his partner [[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]] until the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Skirmish on unidentified planet (Jenna)|freed]] them. Following the Hutts' defeat, Jenna and the rest of the colonists boarded Solo's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="TCK" />
